nodes.description: Owner address of the Ownable contract; set to msg.sender in the constructor and updated in transferOwnership.
Address of the tier (crowdsale) contract allowed to call onlyTier-protected functions.
Price of one token in wei; set in the constructor and mutated by updateRate.
Constructor of Ownable that assigns msg.sender as the initial owner.
Owner-only function transferring ownership to newOwner.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner; applied to transferOwnership, setTier, FlatPricingExt constructor.
Interface self-description returning true.
Interface self-check returning true.
Interface hook telling whether a purchaser is a presale buyer; returns false.
Interface declaration for updating the token rate.
Interface declaration computing the token amount for a wei value.
Safe multiplication with overflow assertion.
Safe division asserting non-zero divisor and exact result.
Safe subtraction asserting b <= a.
Safe addition asserting no overflow.
Owner-only one-time setter of the tier address.
Owner-only constructor setting the initial token price.
Tier-only function mutating oneTokenInWei and emitting RateChanged.
Computes token amount as value * 10**decimals / oneTokenInWei.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == tier; guards updateRate.
msg.sender used as the initial owner in the Ownable constructor.
msg.sender compared against owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender compared against tier inside the onlyTier modifier.
uint c = a * b inside times; relies on assertion for overflow safety.
uint c = a + b inside plus; relies on assertion for overflow safety.
uint multiplier = 10 ** decimals; exponentiation with caller-supplied decimals.
value.times(multiplier) / oneTokenInWei; division by a state price that could be zero.

tier = _tier stores the privileged tier/crowdsale address.
New owner address passed to transferOwnership.
Crowdsale address argument of isSane.
Purchaser address argument of isPresalePurchase.
New rate argument of the PricingStrategy.updateRate interface.
Wei value argument of FlatPricingExt.calculatePrice.
Token decimals argument of FlatPricingExt.calculatePrice.
First multiplicand of SafeMathLibExt.times.
Second multiplicand of SafeMathLibExt.times.
Tier address argument of setTier.
Initial price argument of the FlatPricingExt constructor.
New price argument of FlatPricingExt.updateRate.
Local product result in SafeMathLibExt.times.
Local sum result in SafeMathLibExt.plus.

edges.reason: The Ownable constructor consumes msg.sender as the privileged owner value.
msg.sender is written directly into the owner state variable.
onlyOwner reads msg.sender and compares it with the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of setTier.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of the FlatPricingExt constructor.
transferOwnership executes the ownership reassignment operation.
The newOwner parameter is consumed by transferOwnership.
The externally supplied newOwner is stored into the owner state variable.
The assignment writes the caller-supplied address into owner.
onlyTier reads msg.sender and compares it with the tier state variable.
onlyTier modifier gates execution of updateRate.
setTier executes the tier assignment operation.
The _tier parameter is consumed by setTier.
The caller-supplied _tier is written into the privileged tier state variable.
The assignment writes the externally supplied address into tier.
The constructor parameter feeds the initial price initialization.
The FlatPricingExt constructor writes oneTokenInWei.
The new rate parameter is consumed by updateRate.
updateRate overwrites the oneTokenInWei state variable.
Both modifiers are declared on the same contract and share the tier state.
calculatePrice performs the exponentiation 10 ** decimals.
calculatePrice performs the multiplication and division producing the token amount.
The decimals parameter feeds the exponentiation operation.
The local multiplier is used as the numerator factor in the price computation.
The exponentiation result is stored into the multiplier local variable.
The value parameter is multiplied to derive the token amount.
The price computation reads the oneTokenInWei state variable as divisor.
calculatePrice delegates the multiplication to the SafeMathLibExt.times library function.
times executes the unchecked multiplication a * b.
Parameter a is an operand of the multiplication.
Parameter b is an operand of the multiplication.
The product is stored into the local variable c.
The local c is returned by times.
plus executes the unchecked addition a + b.
The sum is stored into the local variable c.
The local c is returned by plus.
divides executes the division a / b after asserting b > 0.
The quotient is stored into the local variable c.
The local c is returned by divides.
minus executes the subtraction a - b after asserting b <= a.
Both functions are part of the PricingStrategy interface implemented by FlatPricingExt.
FlatPricingExt.calculatePrice overrides the PricingStrategy.calculatePrice interface signature.
FlatPricingExt.updateRate overrides the PricingStrategy.updateRate interface signature.

normalization_plan.reason: The newOwner parameter only exists as input to transferOwnership and should be absorbed by that function node.
The crowdsale parameter is used solely by the isSane interface function.
The purchaser parameter is used solely by isPresalePurchase.
The rate parameter belongs exclusively to the updateRate interface declaration.
The value parameter only feeds the price computation of calculatePrice.
The decimals parameter is the direct operand of the exponentiation operation 10 ** decimals.
Parameter a is an operand of the multiplication operation and carries no independent semantics.
Parameter b is an operand of the multiplication operation and carries no independent semantics.
The _tier parameter is used only as the argument of setTier.
The constructor argument is only used to initialize the token price.
The new rate argument is used only by updateRate.
The local product variable is fully determined by the multiplication operation.
The local sum variable is fully determined by the addition operation.
The local quotient variable is fully determined by the division operation.
The multiplier local holds exactly the result of 10 ** decimals and has no other use.
